in_sanskrit.name: अमर्कुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Amarkumar' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'अमर' (amr) which means 'immortal' and 'कुमार' (kumar) which means 'prince'. Together, these words form the name 'Amarkumar', which can be translated to mean 'Immortal Prince'.

in_hindi.name: अमरकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Amarkumar' in Hindi is composed of the words 'अमर' (amr) which means 'immortal' and 'कुमार' (kumar) which means 'prince'. Therefore, 'Amarkumar' can be understood as 'Immortal Prince' in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: அமர்குமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'Amarkumar' is formed by combining the words 'அமர்' (amr), which means 'immortal', and 'குமார்' (kumar), which means 'prince'. Thus, 'Amarkumar' can be interpreted as 'Immortal Prince' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: అమర్కూమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'Amarkumar' is derived from the words 'అమర్' (amr), which means 'immortal', and 'కూమార్' (kumar), which means 'prince'. Hence, 'Amarkumar' can be translated as 'Immortal Prince' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Amarkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amarkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ama Ra Kuma R: Ama (God) Ra (Labor) Kuma (Lord) R (Of): God's labor, or the labor of the Lord.
